sloka: परिव्राजक रूपेण वैदेहीम् अन्ववर्तत ।ताम् आससाद अतिबलो भ्रातृभ्याम् रहिताम् वने ॥३-४६-४॥
transliteration: parivrājaka rūpeṇa vaidehīm anvavartata ।tām āsasāda atibalo bhrātṛbhyām rahitām vane ॥3-46-4॥

translations.english: Mighty Ravana approached Sita deprived of both the brothers, Like darkness encompasses the evening twilight in the absence of the Sun and the Moon.
